On Reddit, Information Technology led at 94.1 (-0.0 day, -0.1 week) with mentions down 24% and sentiment -0.03 (NVDA, ANT, MU); Financial Services fell 7.6 to 60.0 (-3.8 week; mentions -60%, sentiment 0.12; FSKAX, VUSXX).

SILVER (#2): A Nov 25 headline says silver fell 3% on inflation and rate-hike fears, while the pull shows +3.7% over 24h, so the news does not explain the ranking.
DLTR (#3): Coverage says Dollar Tree beat earnings expectations (32 positive, 0 negative of 41 articles), which plausibly explains the high attention.
SPOT (#4): The headlines are MarketBeat stock-screener lists and do not explain the ranking.

UST10Y (#6): Same two items as the 30-year yield; they do not clearly explain the ranking.
GOLD (#7): A piece on pawn shops booming on gold and a Bitcoin outlook story; neither clearly explains the ranking.
BBY (#8): The headlines are about holiday shopping traffic across retailers and do not clearly explain the ranking.

ANF is first (score 0.971) with attention and X attention at the top of this pull (100th percentile each), volume at the 99th and a 0.94-sigma price move (79th); it has no listed catalyst. Silver is second (0.951): volume is the strongest in the pull (100th percentile), attention and X attention are both at the 98th, and the 1.29-sigma move is at the 92nd; no listed catalyst. Dollar Tree is third (0.894), carried by attention and X attention (99th percentile each), with volume at the 85th and a smaller 0.39-sigma move (43rd); no listed catalyst.
